pages.text: Generator Matrix: closed casing box (basic 3x3x3 / advanced 5x5x5) with controller and ports on walls.$(li)Basic: 45x burn speed, 1.5x output$(li)Advanced: 200x burn speed, 3x output
Purifier Matrix: 3x3x3 closed box, 30x purification at 150 e/t.$(br2)$(2,4)Life Matrix$(0): 3x3x3 box converting Akaishi Energy to Life Energy at 45x. See the Book of Life.
